# Widget theorem

::: {#o1 .subject cue=lead name="Widget theorem"}

In [group theory](wikipedia://en/41890), the **widget theorem** states that every finite widget of odd order has a fixed point under each automorphism of the group.

:::

## Proof

::: {#PRF1 .proof}

The proof takes a minimal counterexample and counts the orbits of the automorphism group on the widget, which gives a contradiction with the odd order of the widget.

:::
